warrants.quote: we issued 128,000 representative warrants, with an exercise price of $6.25, to purchase common stock to the underwriter
The Preferred Investment Options became exercisable on January 23, 2023 and are exercisable at any time on or after January 23, 2023 through January 29, 2026, at an exercise price of $9.65 per share
